summary: Audit export: resume-token entropy profiling, deduplication gaps, and legal-chain signed manifest request
description:
Issue summary: Customer requests a deterministic audit export playbook for their SIEM onboarding. They report observed gaps when resuming incremental exports using resume tokens: duplicate events across batches for tenant T-8765 and occasional sequence discontinuities. They also require a signed 'legal-chain' manifest per export (RFC-like hash chain, signer identity, and KMS key-id) for audit and legal acceptance.
Impact: Customer cannot ingest incremental feed into their downstream forensic indexer without manual de-duplication and cannot provide tamper-evidence to legal. Affects monthly compliance delivery and onboarding timeline.
Environment: Production export pipeline (audit-exporter v2.7.1) -> webhook-bridge -> S3 staging bucket -> customer SIEM connector.
Request: 1) Investigation into resume-token entropy/profile and why duplicates appear for tenant-scoped exports. 2) Signed manifest format sample and guidance to verify chain (hash-of-batch, previous-anchor, signer-kid). 3) Short-term workaround to provide consistent, non-duplicated bundle while we root-cause.
Desired deliverables: playbook steps, manifest JSON schema example, signed sample export (1-day slice) and checksum, and runbook to validate resume token continuity.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) In customer's account create tenant T-8765 with high-churn activity (many short-lived sessions).
2) Start incremental export from timestamp t0 using resume-token A produced by audit-exporter v2.7.1.
3) Allow export to run for ~30 minutes, then snapshot and rotate resume-token.
4) Restart incremental export using the saved resume-token A; observe event ids overlapping with previous batch and missing sequence numbers between offsets 4502 and 4521.
5) Verify webhook-bridge delivered two identical event ids to S3 staging within the same hour window.

investigation_notes:
Hypothesis 1: Resume-token derivation includes a timestamp bucket that drifts when exporter leader changes, causing partial overlap when in-flight buffers flush. Hypothesis 2: Intermittent duplicate delivery from webhook-bridge retry logic when ack from S3 is delayed and resume-token not advanced. Correlation: duplicated event_ids cluster around leader handoffs at ~09:32 UTC.
Checked: exporter leader handoff logs, webhook-bridge delivery retry logs, and S3 put latency. No obvious time skew >1s on exporter nodes, but webhook-bridge retry jitter was set to aggressive (3s) and S3 transient 5xx recorded at 09:33:48-09:33:52Z.
Next steps: instrument resume-token composition (fields and entropy), add per-batch UUID anchor to manifest, add dedup-window in export manifest metadata, and run backfill of suspected duplicated ranges for T-8765.

comments: 2026-03-12 - Elise Nguyen: Opened ticket after receiving legal request from Helix Bank. Attached initial sample of duplicated ids and S3 keys.
2026-03-12 - Samir Patel: Acknowledged, will triage with export runtime and bridge owners. Setting priority to P1 given compliance impact.

2026-03-13 - Jordan Blake (runtime): Initial review indicates resume-token contains (leaderId, offset, bucketTs). Leader handoff may result in same offset interpreted under different leader contexts. Proposing to include a batch-anchor hash in token or manifest.

2026-03-13 - Priya Kapoor (bridge): Observed 5xx window from S3 that triggered two bridge retries; bridge logs show duplicate post attempts. We'll add idempotency-key header in next bridge patch. Refer PR linked.

2026-03-14 - Support (Samir Patel): Collected signed manifest sample and produced 1-day bundle as interim deliverable (see resolution). Asking customer to validate ingest using provided dedupe-hint field.
resolution:
Partial workaround delivered: generated a one-day signed snapshot (2026-03-11) with per-event canonical_id and top-level manifest signed with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01. Manifest includes fields: batch_id, batch_hash (sha256), previous_anchor, signer_kid, kms_signature. Provided ndjson bundle to customer SFTP and a validation script that checks chain continuity and dedup-hint.
Engineering fixes planned: (1) exporter: include batch_anchor hash in resume-token and manifest (PR slated), (2) webhook-bridge: add idempotency-key and exponential backoff guard (PR merged to staging), (3) add monitoring alert for resume-token overlap ratio >0.5% per tenant.
Follow-ups: schedule canary deploy of resume-token change to staging next week, then gradual rollout to prod after 72h of stability. Customer-runbook updated with instructions to request full-snapshot exports until change is live.
post_resolution_actions: Create internal RFC for resume-token v2 including batch_anchor and signer_kid fields
Add e2e test that simulates leader handoff + bridge retry to assert zero duplicates
Notify compliance PM and update SOC2 evidence pack with signed-manifest sample
customer_confirmation: 2026-03-14 - Helix Bank (security@helixbank.com): Confirmed receipt of signed snapshot and validation script. Stated legal team will accept manifest format pending small formatting note on signer_kid. Requested formal SOC2 evidence mapping by 2026-03-18.
